catalog.summary: Label, control, help and error for one input.

header.reason: A button is labelable content, which HTML forbids inside a label other than the control it labels, and a press on it would move focus to the control. The header gives the help, the indicator, the action and the counter a place beside the label rather than inside it. A field with a label alone writes the label on the root.

help.name: messages.help
help.reason: The tooltip layer exists only while it is open, so the control and the button are described by a hidden node carrying the same text; the tooltip describes nothing, so the hint is not read twice. The family controls the tooltip's open and toggles it on activation, because a tooltip alone opens on a coarse pointer only by a long press.

literals.--slotted-field-label-inline-size: 12rem is a line length rather than a step on a scale: the width at which a label of about twenty characters at the md step sits on one line beside its control. No scale in docs/token-foundation.md holds a line length.
literals.reflowBreakpoint: 320px is literal because CSS forbids a custom property in a container condition, which docs/token-foundation.md rule 4 records.
literals.--slotted-field-width-short: 6rem is a line length rather than a step on a scale: the width of an integer of up to four digits at the md step with the control's padding and a stepper. No scale in docs/token-foundation.md holds a line length.
literals.--slotted-field-width-medium: 15rem is a line length rather than a step on a scale: the width of an amount, a code or a short word at the md step with the control's padding and a trailing affordance. No scale in docs/token-foundation.md holds a line length.
